name: Suspicious Child Process Of Manage Engine ServiceDesk
description: Detects suspicious child processes of the "Manage Engine ServiceDesk Plus" Java web service
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate sub processes started by Manage Engine ServiceDesk Pro
query: ((process.parent.executable:*\\ManageEngine\\ServiceDesk\\* AND process.parent.executable:*\\java.exe*) AND (process.executable:(*\\AppVLP.exe OR *\\bash.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\calc.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\forfiles.exe OR *\\mftrace.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\notepad.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\query.exe OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\schtasks.exe OR *\\scrcons.exe OR *\\sh.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\wscript.exe))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe)) AND process.command_line:*\ stop*))
